segments.evidence: Wrangler ® is an iconic American heritage brand rooted in the western lifestyle, with 79 years of history offering denim, apparel, footwear and accessories.

segments.name: Lee
segments.description: Offers Lee-branded denim, apparel, footwear and accessories with trend-forward styles, innovative fabric solutions and advanced design technology to a broad consumer base.
segments.evidence: Lee ® is an iconic American brand offering denim, apparel, footwear and accessories, with 137 years of heritage and authenticity.

segments.name: Helly Hansen
segments.description: Sells technical outdoor and workwear apparel, footwear and accessories to professionals and outdoor consumers through global wholesale and direct-to-consumer channels.
segments.evidence: Helly Hansen ® is a global technical outdoor and workwear brand headquartered in Oslo, Norway with 149 years of history, which operates a global wholesale and direct-to-consumer business across outdoor and workwear apparel, footwear, and accessories.

revenueModel.text: Wholesale retailers, direct-to-consumer shoppers and licensees pay for branded apparel, footwear and accessories, and for the use of the brands.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company designs, manufactures, procures, sells and licenses apparel, footwear and accessories, primarily under the brand names Wrangler ® , Lee ® and Helly Hansen ® .

changes.text: In 2025 the company added the Helly Hansen reportable segment through its acquisition of the Helly Hansen and Musto brands.
